newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria retail sales rise 1.0 pct in Jan-Aug.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria retail sales rise 1.0 pct in Jan-Aug.

text.p: Bulgarian retail sales were a real one percent higher in the first eight months of 1996 than a year earlier, but fell a real 2.8 percent in August year-on-year, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said.
BULGARIA RETAIL SALES JAN-AUG JAN-JULY JAN-AUG'95

Retail sales in August alone fell year-on year for the third month in a row. Sales in August were down by a real 2.8 percent from the same month of 1995, to 73.6 billion levs in current prices. Food sales declined a real 3.5 percent year-on-year while sales of non-foods fell 2.2 percent.
